# Penn State College of Health and Human Development

> > Penn State's College of Health and Human Development (HHD) offers interdisciplinary undergraduate and graduate programs across eight departments including Kinesiology, Human Development and Family Studies, Communication Sciences and Disorders, Nutritional Sciences, Health Policy and Administration, and Recreation, Park, and Tourism Management.

HHD houses world-class research centers and provides comprehensive education in health sciences, family studies, speech-language pathology, hospitality management, and biobehavioral health. The college serves students at University Park and through Penn State World Campus with programs ranging from undergraduate majors to doctoral degrees.

## Key Topics

- Penn State College of Health and Human Development (HHD)
- Communication Sciences and Disorders (CSD)

- [Health and Human Development](https://hhd.psu.edu): Penn State College of Health and Human Development homepage
- [About Health and Human Development](https://hhd.psu.edu/about-health-and-human-development): Overview of Penn State HHD's eight interdisciplinary programs and mission
- [Discover HHD](https://hhd.psu.edu/discover-hhd): Explore HHD's nine majors through Instagram Ambassador student accounts
- [Research](https://hhd.psu.edu/research): HHD's four world-class research centers and innovative breakthroughs

## Academic Departments

- [Communication Sciences and Disorders Home](https://hhd.psu.edu/csd): CSD department offering speech-language pathology and audiology programs
- [Human Development and Family Studies](https://hhd.psu.edu/hdfs): HDFS department offering undergraduate and graduate family studies programs
- [About Human Development and Family Studies](https://hhd.psu.edu/hdfs/about-human-development-and-family-studies): HDFS premier program in child development, aging, and family studies
- [Health Policy and Administration](https://hhd.psu.edu/hpa): HPA department with undergraduate/graduate programs and opioid research
- [Nutritional Sciences](https://hhd.psu.edu/nutrition): Nutritional Sciences department with nutrition and dietetics programs
- [Recreation, Park, and Tourism Management](https://hhd.psu.edu/rptm): RPTM department with recreation, tourism, and PGA Golf Management programs

## Undergraduate Programs

- [Health and Human Development Undergraduate Programs](https://hhd.psu.edu/undergraduate): HHD undergraduate degree options across nine academic departments
- [Nutritional Sciences Undergraduate Program](https://hhd.psu.edu/nutrition/undergraduate): Undergraduate nutrition programs with dietetics and health sciences options
- [HHD Academic Consultation Tips](https://hhd.psu.edu/undergraduate/nso/academic-consultation-tips): New student orientation tips for HHD academic consultation and enrollment

## Graduate Programs

- [About the M.S. Program](https://hhd.psu.edu/csd/ms/about): CSD Master of Science program for speech-language pathology training
